turns.replyTail:

Logging into your Nom Nom account
Going to the Plan page → Your Next Box → Manage Delivery → Reschedule
Picking an earlier delivery date and confirming

Just be sure to do this before your order deadline shown under “Make changes by…” in Your Next Box.
